claim.claim-text: 1. A medical device delivery system for delivering a medical implant, comprising:

2. The medical device delivery system of claim 1, wherein the release assembly releasably couples the lock line handle to the handle via a slide release (2342A), a slide (2342A) and catch (2341A), a pin (3304C) and detent (3310H), or a push-button release (6310A).

3. The medical device delivery system of claim 1, wherein the release assembly comprises a push-button release (6310A) having a flap (6310B) configured to move outwardly from a locked position in which the flap (6310B) engages the handle (3304) to an unlocked position in which the flap (6310B) is disengaged from the handle (3304) allowing release of the lock line handle (6310) therefrom.
4. The medical delivery device system of claim 1, wherein the lock line handle (3310, 4310, 5310, 6310, 7310) comprises a spool (33041, 6310E) to wind the lock line (92).
5. The medical device delivery system of claim 4, wherein
6. The medical device delivery system of claim 1, wherein:

the lock line handle (2310, 3310, 4310, 5310, 6310, 7310) is configured to be moved between a lock position and an unlock position; and further wherein actuating from the lock position toward the unlocked position increases a tension on the lock line (92), and actuating the lock line handle (2310, 3310, 4310, 5310, 6310, 7310) from the unlock position toward the lock position decreases the tension on the lock line (92).

7. The medical device delivery system of claim 6, wherein each of increasing and decreasing the tension on the lock line (92) is achieved by rotating the lock line handle (3310, 4310, 5310, 6310, 7310).

8. The medical device delivery system of claim 6, further comprising a lock assembly to selectively secure the lock line handle (2310, 3310, 4310, 5310, 6310, 7310) in each of the lock position and unlock position.
9. The medical device delivery system of claim 3, wherein the lock assembly comprises a pin (2331, 3304C, 7310E) and detent (2332B, 3310H, 7310C).

10. The medical device delivery system of claim 8, wherein the lock assembly includes: a plurality of detents (3310H) along a surface of the lock line handle (3310), and a pin (3304C) to engage with the plurality of detents (3310H).

11. The medical delivery device system of claim 6, wherein the lock line handle (2310) is configured to translate linearly relative the handle (3304) to actuate between the lock position and the unlock position.
12. The medical delivery device system of claim 6, wherein the lock line handle (2310, 3310, 4310, 5310, 6310, 7310) is T-shaped (4310), a thumb slide (2310), or pear shaped (3310, 6310, 7310).

13. The medical delivery device system of claim 1, wherein the lock line handle (6310) includes a swivel head set screw (6310J) securing the first end portion (92A) of the lock line (92) to the lock line handle (6310).

14. The medical delivery device system of claim 1, wherein the catheter (302) defines at least one lumen extending between the proximal end portion (322) and the distal end portion (324); and an intermediate portion (92C) of the lock line (92) extends through the at least one lumen.
15. The medical delivery device system of claim 1, wherein the medical implant comprises an implantable fixation device (14) including

a first arm (18) moveable between a first position and a second position, a second arm (18) moveable between a first position and a second position; wherein when the lock line handle (2310, 3310, 4310, 5310, 6310, 7310) is in the lock position the first arm (18) and the second arm (18) are restricted at least from moving from the respective first positions toward the respective second positions, and further wherein when the lock line handle (3310, 4310, 5310, 6310, 7310) is in the unlock position the first arm and second arm (18) can be moved freely between the respective first positions and respective second positions.
